items.text:
At its current stage its super janky, things are broken or missing, the main space station tends to run out of breathable air sooner or later, brain dead ai keeps trying to ram into me, yet it's still stupidly compelling to just head on out into space, find a ship and loot it of all usable parts to make yourself rich. 

Or at least rich enough to afford a toilet for your ship so you can stop pooping yourself in your suit.
items.text_zh:
在目前这个阶段，它超级粗糙，东西要么坏了要么缺失，主空间站迟早会耗尽可呼吸的空气，脑残的AI老是试图撞我，然而它仍然蠢得让人着迷，就是直接飞进太空，找到一艘飞船，把里面所有能用的零件都搜刮一空，让自己发财。

或者至少富到能给你的飞船买得起一个马桶，这样你就不用在自己的宇航服里拉屎了。

observations.evidence: brain dead ai keeps trying to ram into me
observations.evidence_zh: 脑死亡的AI一直试图撞向我
